ai.title: Add GITHUB ACTIONS RUNTIME switch defaulting to convex
ai.summary: A new constant, GITHUB_ACTIONS_RUNTIME, and its type, GitHubActionsRuntime, are added to common/src/constants/github-backend.ts to control where GitHub actions execute. The constant currently defaults to convex, which executes actions in Convex while reading and writing the Postgres store through the githubStore bridge. The documentation notes this switch requires GITHUB_BACKEND to be set to postgres and describes a future freebuff_web mode where actions run in-process on Postgres. The change is a preparatory switch that does not yet alter runtime execution behavior because the default remains convex.

ai.title: Optional version in Layer 2 sponsored skill schema with recorded
ai.summary: The `layer2Package` schema in `common/src/ads/sponsored-skill-layer2.ts` now treats `version` as optional for both npm and PyPI ecosystems, allowing the source record to omit explicit version pins. The `buildLayer2Skill` function accepts a new releases map parameter to substitute recorded releases for unpinned packages, using `layer2PackageKey` to match; a package with neither a source pin nor a recorded release is refused. In `compileLayer2Skill`, the version field is now emitted as an empty string when missing, rather than requiring a valid version at compile time.

ai.title: Switch GitHub actions runtime to Freebuff Web
ai.summary: The `GITHUB_ACTIONS_RUNTIME` constant in `common/src/constants/github-backend.ts` was flipped from `'convex'` to `'freebuff_web'`. This moves the execution of GitHub actions (such as webhooks, OAuth callbacks, and token rotation) from Convex to the Freebuff Web service, which runs the same action bodies in-process on Postgres. The change relies on `GITHUB_BACKEND` already being set to `'postgres'`, as indicated in the file's JSDoc.
ai.evidence: The diff modifies `common/src/constants/github-backend.ts`, changing the value of the `GITHUB_ACTIONS_RUNTIME` constant from `'convex'` to `'freebuff_web'`.
